changes.description: Added a versioned smithy-agent-skills artifact that packages reviewable Agent Skills, starting with smithy-docs-navigator for navigating Smithy documentation.
Added a cap to selector recursion depth to prevent malformed selectors
Extended the `@idempotent` trait with optional `exists` and `notFound` properties to declare the errors returned when encountering unexpected resource states.
Fix duplicate search box in smithy doc page
Updated trait docs to show what package the trait is defined in.

Fixed trait code generation for shapes with an `@idRef`-annotated member or member's target, which produced uncompilable code. The generated default value for a member didn't respect `@idRef` trait on member or member's target and generated vanilla string literal, while generated member type is `ShapeId`.
Clean orphaned endpoint ruleset params after shape removal
Updated CLI to use JDK 25 and AOT cache instead of AppCDS.
Fix changelog action for external contributor PRs
The `RemovedOperationBinding` diff event is now a `NOTE` instead of an `ERROR` when a service operation is moved to a resource within the same service closure
